title: Files in DCLab Code: @ names a file in the message box, a path in the conversation opens it (parity A3)
request: The owner's goal (2026-10-25, restated 2026-10-26: continue non-stop): DCLab Code with the capabilities of Claude Code and Codex desktop in a calmer UI, built from the R&D project; parity plan step A3: files.
plan: list a session's (or a project's) files as git sees them, ranked for what is typed
show one file, inside the folder only, never a sealed set
the @ picker in the message box (keys, Esc)
backticked paths and links to relative paths open the File tab at their line
record the person's look as their step (the path, never the content), and give it to R&D's store as a person step
tests, a check in the browser pane, a review

decisions.decision: The file list is git's own (tracked files and new ones it does not ignore), cached 15 seconds; a folder that is no repository is walked within 20,000 files
decisions.why: git already knows what belongs to the project: build output, virtual environments and data the person ignored stay out without a second set of rules

decisions.decision: A sealed or holdout set is listed and marked, never shown; the File tab refuses it with its reason (403)
decisions.why: the person may name it on purpose (the agent is then asked before it reads it); showing its rows in the app would be a read of the set

decisions.decision: A path is a link only in backticks or as a Markdown link to a relative path; the server decides what may be shown
decisions.why: plain prose holds dotted words (e.g., v1.2) that are no files; the agent is asked to write paths in backticks

decisions.decision: The person's look at a file is recorded as file_opened (path, line, sealed, by) and becomes a person:open_file step in R&D's episodes, without its path
decisions.why: the owner's rule: every act is captured for training; the content-free episode keeps no file names

change: dclab-code: server/files.js (FileIndex, rankFiles, readView, isSealed), GET /api/files and /api/file in server/app.js, web/files.js (mentionAt, applyMention), web/md.js (fileRef, file links), the @ picker and the File tab in web/app.js, index.html and style.css, the system prompt's line on paths. R&D: dclab_rnd/store/sets/dclab_code.py reads file_opened as person:open_file.

findings.defect: looks at a file were recorded that never happened
findings.scenario: the File tab's refresh, leaving it and coming back, and a file opened in session A then the File tab in session B each wrote another file_opened record (B's for a file never opened there)
findings.cause: every draw asked the server, and the server recorded every view; the view stayed across sessions
findings.fix: only the click records (open=1); the view belongs to its session
findings.test: tests/server.test.js: files (a redraw is not a look)

findings.defect: a late answer drew over the side panel
findings.scenario: a file link clicked, then the Changes tab before the answer came: the file replaced the diff; the browser check then found the diff's late answer drawing over the File tab too
findings.cause: no check after the await (in the new File tab and the older diff)
findings.fix: both return when another tab or file was chosen meanwhile

findings.defect: a link to a sealed set was listed as not sealed
findings.scenario: copy.csv -> sealed/test.csv and innocent -> sealed/ showed sealed: false in the picker (the view refused both)
findings.cause: isSealed checked the given path only
findings.fix: the real path is checked too
findings.test: tests/units.test.js: the picker marks a link to a sealed set

findings.defect: the file list could start a git per request, keep old folders forever, and a walk could fill with a venv
findings.scenario: requests during a cold cache each ran git; removed copies stayed in memory; a non-repository with venv/ filled 20,000 slots with site-packages
findings.cause: a cache of results, never pruned; the walk's skip list and no folder limit
findings.fix: the cache holds the promise and drops old folders; venv, env, site-packages skipped; at most 5,000 folders opened

measurements.name: dclab-code tests
measurements.gate: every test passes; each new route and helper tested
measurements.result: 82+ tests, page tests skipped (no Chromium here); units 33 of 33; the files route test

measurements.name: browser pane check
measurements.gate: the picker lists, filters, marks a sealed file, inserts on Enter, closes on Esc; a file link opens the File tab at its line; a sealed link is refused
measurements.result: @tra listed src/train.py and data/train.csv; Down+Enter inserted @data/train.csv; @hold marked data/holdout.csv sealed; Esc closed the list, not the panel; src/train.py:3 opened with line 3 highlighted; data/holdout.csv refused with its reason; no script errors

measurements.name: R&D store test
measurements.gate: a person's look is a person step without its path; a script's is not

outcome: In DCLab Code a person names a file with @ and opens any file the agent names, at its line, as in Claude Code; a sealed set stays unshown.
lessons: Let the repository's own tool (git) decide what a project's files are.
risks: a very large repository: git ls-files is bounded by a 15 s timeout and a 64 MB buffer
the page tests in Chromium did not run (no browser on this machine)
